_comment: Allen Mouse Brain Atlas (P56, structure graph 1) structures -> /regions mouse region keys.
Hand-curated. Rules are tried in order; a drawn Allen structure goes to the FIRST rule
whose `allen` ids include the structure or one of its ancestors (structure_id_path).
Order matters: olfactory bulb and hippocampal formation sit under Allen's cortical plate,
so they come before the cortex rule. Structures matching no rule (pallidum, fiber
tracts, ventricles, ...) are drawn grey and are not clickable. A null region drops
the matched structures; an entry with exact=true matches only that structure, not its
descendants (OLF itself is drawn as a backdrop polygon around the olfactory bulb, so it
must not paint as cortex; its children such as piriform area still do).
`uberon` must equal the region's id in web/lib/brain-regions.ts (checked by the tests).
